title: Cross Site Scripting in Markdown renderer in Apache JSPWIKI 2.4 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows attacker to…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Markdown renderer of Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.4 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. This flaw allows attackers to bypass HTML encoding and potentially inject raw HTML or JavaScript code that executes in users' browsers. The issue is resolved in version 3.0.1.
